    batch_size, trajectory_length = observations.shape[:2]

        def process_env_trajectory(env_idx):
            env_rnn_state = jax.tree.map(lambda x: jax.lax.stop_gradient(x[env_idx]), initial_rnn_states)
            def step_fn(carry, t):

                return jax.tree.map(lambda x: x[0], new_rnn_state_b), (logits_b[0], value_b[0])
            _, (env_logits, env_values) = lax.scan(step_fn, env_rnn_state, jnp.arange(trajectory_length))

        policy_loss2 = jnp.clip(ratio, 1 - clip_epsilon, 1 + clip_epsilon) * adv_detached
        policy_loss = -jnp.mean(jnp.minimum(policy_loss1, policy_loss2))

        entropy = -jnp.mean(jnp.sum(jax.nn.softmax(all_logits, axis=-1) * log_probs_all, axis=-1))
